scope: Independent post-freeze review of current Mac notification attachment bounds, cleanup, fallback, and Android metadata contract.
sourceBasis: Fresh absolute filesystem read; prior pre-freeze snapshot finding withdrawn.

findings.finding: NotificationArtwork owns staging directories, but NotificationBridge tracks only a UUID token per notification ID, not the staged object. clearContexts(), replacement, tombstone removal, and reply/dismiss revoke retry authority but cannot immediately call artwork.cleanup(staged). The directory is removed when the add callback runs; if that callback is delayed or never arrives, cleanup depends on configure() cleanupStale() after 24 hours.

evidence.detail: stage records directory ownership and cleanup requires the Staged value.
Bridge stores UUID tokens and callback-local staged value; invalidation does not retain staged for immediate cleanup.
clear/removal revoke tokens and remove OS IDs but do not invoke artwork.cleanup.
Stale cleanup is limited to startup and entries older than 24 hours.

findings.finding: The dismiss response removes artwork retry authority and message bookkeeping, but does not call removeDeliveredAndPending([id]). Successful reply does call direct delivered removal; shared removal is used for tombstones/replacements. A pending same-ID request is therefore not explicitly removed by dismiss handling.

evidence.detail: Dismiss path only removes token and bookkeeping.
Reply path removes token and delivered notification.
Shared helper removes both delivered and pending notifications.

findings.finding: The current helper validates canonical Base64, decoded bytes <=16,384, PNG type, exactly one image, dimensions 1...96, and rejects APNG control chunks before rendering. It re-encodes a fixed 96x96 PNG with the phone badge, stages under a 0700 UUID directory, uses a public UNNotificationAttachment, and removes staging after add completion. Attachment add failure retries once with the same text/actions and no attachment, guarded by the current token.

evidence.detail: Input and static PNG validation plus bounded compositing.
Bounded owned staging and attachment creation with failure cleanup.
Subtitle decoration, attachment submission, callback cleanup, token guard, and text-only retry.

findings.finding: Mac passes paired phone name only when the envelope source device matches the active pairing. HFP call notifications remain on the existing path without decoration; mirrored call identity remains peer ID plus notification key. Android decoration uses only the source package and runs outside ReplyDispatchLock; durable replay strips icon bytes and replyToken.

evidence.detail: Paired phone context is gated by source device identity.
HFP path submits ordinary content; optional decoration is used for mirrored/message paths.
Package lookup/rendering is outside the serialized reply lock.

nativeUIPresentation: Not assessed as proven by source or static tests; parent owns native presentation evidence.

androidManifestReview.finding: The frozen change adds exactly one package-visibility query for ACTION_MAIN with CATEGORY_LAUNCHER. It does not add QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES, broad package enumeration, permissions, or unrelated intent queries.

evidence.detail: The only <queries> entry contains MAIN and LAUNCHER.
Existing permissions are unchanged in the reviewed manifest.
Application, launcher activity, handoff activity, provider, and services remain otherwise unchanged for this review.

androidManifestReview.securityBounds: The helper still receives sbn.packageName and performs direct PackageManager lookup; metadata remains optional and failures omit decoration.
androidManifestReview.limitation: The query covers discoverable launcher apps only. Nonlauncher source packages can still omit optional source metadata; no universal icon claim is made.

launcherEvidence.claim: Parent evidence reports the real launcher image is unclipped; this review preserves that claim as launcher evidence only and does not extend it to nonlauncher packages.

parentStatus: Parent corrected Swift tests running; package gate follows. Luna performed source-only review.

verified.detail: Objective-C checks class presence, factory/setter/getter selectors, exact argument counts and return/argument encodings before objc_msgSend; absent/mismatched APIs return nil.
@try/@catch covers icon factory, mutable content copy, setter, request construction/copy, copied-icon read, and center submission; exception details are not logged.
Icon is applied to a copied content/request. The untouched public content is retained for ordinary fallback. No KVC, helper bundle, sender substitution, fake person, or entitlement change.
NotificationArtwork uses public NSImage systemSymbolName iphone and composites the white/blue circular phone badge into the left-icon PNG.
The new path creates no temporary files or attachment staging. Earlier temporary artwork namespace is outside this patch and remains parent-owned cleanup.

findings.detail: When an icon-bearing request fails, the plain retry calls submit(content,id:) without a generation token. If the same notification ID is replaced before that plain retry fails, the old fallback completion can remove bookkeeping/report an error for the newer replacement. Existing tests cover icon failure followed by plain failure but not replacement during the plain retry.
findings.resolution: All submissions, including the plain fallback, now acquire a per-ID token; completion gates every effect on current ownership. Regression test covers stale plain fallback failure versus same-ID replacement.

findings.detail: handleResponse dismissal removes artworkSubmissions and message bookkeeping but does not call removeDeliveredAndPending([id]); a pending same-ID request is not explicitly canceled. Tests assert retry suppression but do not assert pending-store removal.
findings.resolution: Dismiss now calls removeDeliveredAndPending([id]) before removing message bookkeeping. Regression test asserts shared pending/delivered removal and ignores late failure.

findings.detail: The private ABI path may be ignored or rejected by the OS. Terra source/tests do not prove left placement or native SF Symbols rendering. Parent owns native proof; the user screenshot is recorded as right-side evidence only and is not reused as left-icon proof.

terraLeftIconReview.testCoverageAssessment: Meaningful coverage exists for missing/mismatched ABI, ordinary fallback, malformed artwork, one retry, cancellation before icon callback, identity/token preservation, and bounded outstanding icon submissions. Missing coverage is replacement during plain fallback and explicit pending removal on dismiss.
